music.dread: only candidate that is a low, steady bed with slow regular throbs (like the brief's sub heartbeat); the others are dense ticking or sectioned
music.road: steady 112 bpm pulse locked to 32 bars, level swing 3.4 dB, no gaps; cand1 has 7 s of silence, cand3 had words detected
music.father: continuous very low drone with a slow swell about every 20 s (breathing), no beat; others tick, drift or have sections
music.decision: 104 bpm pulse aligned so the last 24 beats are the loop cycle; long file builds from sparse hits to dense; cand1/2 failed the leading-silence contract
music.decision_loop: same generation as music.decision cand3 (shared gain, hand-off continuous)
music.resolve: smooth sustained pad that steps from one chord to another and fades; the others are chord stabs or end in silence
music.launch: build with a rising line and a clear step into the drive, kick on the first sample after 20.000 s; cand1 was preferred on the build but its loop file had a word detected after the kick alignment (Bye.), so the whole pair moved to cand2
music.launch_loop: drive cycle of the same generation, 16 bars at 144 bpm, kick on sample 0, steady (4 dB swing)
music.fight: 152 bpm, kick and low hits, two breakdown sections like the brief; cand1 is a flat wall of hits
music.fight_final: 172 bpm, constant maximum intensity and brighter top end; cand2 has a 4 s near-silent hole, cand3 had words detected
music.defeat: one decaying low cluster with no rhythm; cand2/3 are repeating chord hits
amb.cicadas: energy concentrated 3.5-9 kHz like the procedural bed, least low-frequency contamination
amb.town_empty: the only one with discrete bell-like strikes (the crossing bell of the cue) over wind
amb.geofront: broad airy/waterfall spectrum closest to the procedural cavern bed
amb.cage: uniform low room tone with faint far events; cand2/3 change timbre abruptly in the second half
amb.city_night: wind-dominated spectrum like the procedural bed, no tone lines
sfx.gunfire_far: separate shots and short bursts with decaying echoes
sfx.jet_pass: smooth bell-shaped Doppler-like swell with no thump at the start
sfx.explosion_far: boom with long decaying rumble, no tone line
sfx.explosion_near: crack, boom and a debris tail
sfx.crash: loud impact decaying over the full length; cand1 is a flat wall of noise that stops abruptly
sfx.car_roll: series of crunching impacts diminishing from the first sample (variant prompt); round 1 gave an engine-like drone
sfx.rig_tear: metallic burst and decay; cand2 is a metronomic tick artefact
sfx.rig_crash: series of metal clanks like a truss bouncing, plus one last bump
sfx.hand_rise: low water/creak rumble, no speech detected
sfx.impact_above: clean deep boom decaying through a long rumble
sfx.impact_above_hard: clean heavy boom; cand2 had speech-like detection
sfx.gate_close: variant prompt: grinding slide for about 4 s, then the massive thud and decay (round 1 candidates all put the thud first)
sfx.door_boom: metallic boom with ringing decay; cand1 had words detected
sfx.cross: variant prompt: only candidate with a slowly rising line and a swell late in the sound; no voices

keep_procedural.music.cage: every candidate is gated or ticking, with abrupt cut-offs between chord blocks; the procedural continuous pad matches the brief better
keep_procedural.music.victory: no candidate is a chord blooming from nothing: noise only, or chord stabs with long holes
keep_procedural.sfx.siren: generated sirens fade in and out within the 20 s and are noisy; the procedural two-cycle tone loop is cleaner and the datapack loops it
keep_procedural.sfx.klaxon: no candidate has three clean pulses in 4 s (the datapack repeats it every 11 s relying on that); the one with two pulses had words detected
keep_procedural.music.descent: not regenerated: its bloom must land at exactly 8.00 s
